name: 40-convert-claude-messages-group-predicate-inplace
description: The second call site of the `startsWithGroupName` predicate (:259-263), on the non-system turns that are rewritten to 'user' when `useSysPrompt` is false. A leading group turn at index 0 is not special-cased -- only the first turn of the *system* run is exempt from the rewrite -- so the message at index 0 takes the same branch as the one at index 2: it already starts with `Corin: `, so the predicate is true and `Iris: ` is withheld, while the turn in between gets the character prefix. `names` comes from the `$promptNames` sentinel, so both sides call a real method-shaped predicate.
